description.en: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) is a flagship scheme of the Government of India aimed at providing free LPG (Liquefied Petroleum Gas) connections to women from Below Poverty Line (BPL) households. The scheme was launched to safeguard the health of women and children by replacing unclean cooking fuels such as firewood, coal, cow-dung cakes, and kerosene with clean LPG fuel. Under PMUY 2.0 (launched in August 2021), the scheme was extended to cover migrant workers and those not covered under any other LPG scheme. The connection is provided in the name of an adult woman of the household, and the Government provides a subsidy to cover the cost of the connection including the security deposit for the cylinder and regulator.

verifiedConditions.appliesTo: Adult women from BPL households without an existing LPG connection
verifiedConditions.claim: The applicant's household must be identified as Below Poverty Line (BPL) based on the Socio Economic and Caste Census (SECC) 2011 data or belong to one of the identified categories: SC/ST households, beneficiaries of Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Gramin), Antyodaya Anna Yojana, forest dwellers, most backward classes, tea and ex-tea garden tribes, or people residing in islands and river islands.
The LPG connection must be issued in the name of an adult woman (18 years or above) of the eligible household. No other member of the household should already have an LPG connection from any OMC.

No member of the applicant's household should have an existing LPG connection from any Oil Marketing Company (Indian Oil, Bharat Petroleum, or Hindustan Petroleum). This is verified through de-duplication checks against the existing LPG consumer database.

unverifiedEligibility: Under PMUY 2.0, migrant workers and those not covered under existing LPG schemes can apply with a self-declaration of address in lieu of address proof.
The SECC 2011 data may not reflect current BPL status — some eligible households may have been missed in the original survey.
Households that surrendered their earlier LPG connection may or may not be eligible for a fresh PMUY connection depending on the reason for surrender.

requirements.claim: Valid KYC (Know Your Customer) document — Aadhaar card of the adult woman applicant. Aadhaar is mandatory for identity verification and de-duplication against existing LPG connections.

Proof of BPL status — the applicant's name must appear in the SECC 2011 list, or the applicant must belong to one of the identified categories (SC/ST household, PMAY-G beneficiary, AAY beneficiary, forest dweller, most backward class, tea garden tribe, or island/river island resident) with supporting documentation.

Address proof such as Aadhaar card, voter ID, or ration card showing the residential address. Under PMUY 2.0, migrant workers who lack address proof can submit a self-declaration of their current address.
Active bank account or Jan Dhan account in the name of the woman applicant for receiving LPG subsidy through Direct Benefit Transfer. The bank account should be Aadhaar-seeded.

Ration card or family composition declaration to verify the household composition and confirm that no other family member already has an LPG connection. If a ration card is not available, a self-declaration may be accepted.

processInformation.claim: Check eligibility on the PMUY website (pmuy.gov.in) by entering the Aadhaar number or name to verify if the household is listed in the SECC 2011 database or belongs to an eligible category.

Visit the nearest LPG distributor (Indian Oil, Bharat Petroleum, or Hindustan Petroleum) with the required documents. Fill the PMUY application form (KYC form with Aadhaar details, bank account details, and address proof). The application can also be submitted online through the PMUY portal or the respective Oil Marketing Company's website.

The LPG distributor verifies the applicant's identity, BPL status through the SECC database, and confirms through de-duplication that no existing LPG connection exists in the household. The application is processed by the concerned Oil Marketing Company.

Upon approval, the free LPG connection (including cylinder, regulator, and a filled LPG refill) is delivered to the beneficiary's address. The cost of the connection is borne by the Government. The beneficiary receives a consumer number and can book subsequent refills through the distributor or online.

output.claim: The beneficiary receives a free LPG connection in her name, consisting of a 14.2 kg LPG cylinder with regulator, a filled LPG refill, and a consumer number with the chosen Oil Marketing Company. The Government bears the cost of the security deposit for the cylinder and regulator (approximately Rs. 1,600). The beneficiary can subsequently book LPG refills and receive LPG subsidy through Direct Benefit Transfer.

fees.applicability: PMUY LPG connection — Government subsidy covers the cost
fees.claim: There is no cost to the beneficiary for the LPG connection under PMUY. The Government provides a subsidy of Rs. 1,600 per connection to cover the security deposit for the cylinder and pressure regulator. Under PMUY 2.0, the first LPG refill is also provided free of cost.

fees.applicability: Subsequent LPG refills after the first free refill
fees.claim: Subsequent LPG refills are to be purchased by the beneficiary at the prevailing market price. The beneficiary receives an LPG subsidy per refill (subject to the annual cap of 12 subsidised cylinders) through Direct Benefit Transfer to her Aadhaar-linked bank account. The refill price and subsidy amount are revised periodically.

processingTime.applicability: PMUY application to LPG connection delivery
processingTime.claim: The LPG connection is typically delivered within 7-15 days from the submission of a complete application with all required documents. Processing time may vary based on the distributor's workload, verification process, and availability of cylinders in the area.

sources.title: PMUY Portal — Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana Official Website
sources.publisher: Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas, Government of India
sources.evidenceExcerpt: PMUY provides free LPG connections to eligible BPL households. The connection is issued in the name of an adult woman of the household. The Government bears the cost of the security deposit (Rs. 1,600). Under PMUY 2.0, the first refill is also provided free. Eligibility is based on SECC 2011 data and identified categories.
claimsSupported: Free LPG connection for BPL households.
Connection must be in the name of an adult woman.
Government subsidy of Rs. 1,600 per connection.
Eligibility based on SECC 2011 and identified categories.
No existing LPG connection in the household.
sources.uncertainty: The scheme's budget allocation and target numbers are subject to annual revision.

sources.title: Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas — PMUY Scheme Guidelines
sources.publisher: Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas, Government of India
sources.evidenceExcerpt: MoPNG oversees PMUY implementation through the three Oil Marketing Companies — Indian Oil Corporation, Bharat Petroleum Corporation, and Hindustan Petroleum Corporation. The scheme aims to provide deposit-free LPG connections to poor households. De-duplication is done against the existing LPG consumer database to prevent double connections.
claimsSupported: LPG subsidy is provided through Direct Benefit Transfer.
sources.uncertainty: LPG subsidy amounts and refill prices are revised periodically by the Government.

limitations: Eligibility is primarily based on SECC 2011 data which may not accurately reflect current economic status of households.
The scheme covers only the initial LPG connection; subsequent refill costs are borne by the beneficiary with subsidy support.
Low refill rates among PMUY beneficiaries have been reported, with some reverting to traditional fuels due to refill costs.
This record does not cover the detailed subsidy calculation or the PAHAL (Direct Benefit Transfer of LPG) scheme mechanics.
Availability of LPG distributors in remote and rural areas may affect access to refills.
The record does not cover the Pradhan Mantri LPG Panchayat initiative for awareness and safe usage promotion.

review.reviewReason: Core scheme verified via PMUY portal. LPG subsidy amounts, refill prices, and eligible category expansions need regular monitoring.
nextReviewTrigger: Changes to the list of eligible categories under PMUY.
Revision of LPG subsidy amounts or the number of subsidised cylinders per year.
Extension of PMUY with new phases or modifications.
Changes to the security deposit amount or connection cost coverage.
Updates to the SECC database or introduction of a new survey for BPL identification.
